KUNINGRIIGID GODOT AUTOPORT — VALIDATED 0.70 BATTLE STRIKE/HIT SYNCHRONIZATION RELEASE
Reason: 0.69 could not publish because Godot imported GLB scenes were not ready; 0.70 fixes the release import gate and synchronizes soldier skeletal attacks/hits to real combat events.
Validated: PR #22 merged as 20a69f30fe54059bea3163622c00f13f6ea146dc.
Required tests: GitHub Actions 41883935821 SUCCESS, including 216 original GLB soldier action clips and all historical Godot, 200-turn economy and source-parity regressions.
Changes: event counters prevent per-frame restart of attack/hit actions; actual damage or projectile impact drives the hit reaction. Imported GLB clips remain non-looping and linked to combat duration.
Release workflow: complete Godot glTF imports with --import, verify all web50 and web53 models before running tests and exporting platform-specific PCKs.
Requested: create stable Android Kuningriigid-Content.pck and Windows content, launcher and engine packages; signed APK only if the existing permanent keystore is available.
No debug-signed APK may be represented as a compatible Android update. Physical Android graphics and FPS remain device-validation items.
